natural.finding: All 52 natural responses match the prior checkpoint: fenced empty arrays. Training concerns 0/20, clean 20/20, complete pairs 0/20; diagnostics concerns 0/6, clean 6/6, complete pairs 0/6. All 52 pass production parsing.

method.scope: Assess cited explanations after supplying the concern branch on the same four fixed prompts.
method.production_usable: The complete assembled response passes production parseReview, including citation validation.
method.exact_citation: The reported bracketed-ID set equals the expected ID set; available alternative causal citations are assessed separately.
method.grounded_causal_reason: The reason identifies a concrete rule conflict or failure mechanism supported by the actual supplied diff and context.
method.full_review_pass: Production-usable review with a grounded causal reason and a causally appropriate available citation, without extra unsupported findings.
method.provenance: Prompt, chunk, forced prefix and decoding settings match across model arms; production parsing was recomputed. Judgments follow manual reading of each complete answer against its actual prompt.

cases.name: scoped-python-analysis-concern
cases.expected_mechanism: Adding Python code in analysis/profile_notes.py conflicts with analysis/AGENTS.md, which permits only Lua and forbids Python; that nearest rule overrides the root developer-script permission.

control.parse_error: Model did not return a complete JSON review
control.assessment: Treats root-to-nearest rule ordering as an import-placement requirement instead of applying the Lua-only directory rule. Reports physical line 11 as line_id although the sole bracketed ID is 1. Appends prose after the JSON object.

new.parse_error: Model finding lacks an exact changed-line citation
new.assessment: Repeats rule-ordering language as an objection to the import statement and never identifies the Python-versus-Lua conflict. Reports physical line 11 as line_id rather than bracketed ID 1. The trailing prose is gone.

cases.name: allocation-null-guard-introduced
cases.expected_mechanism: Removing the allocation-failure guard lets a failed calloc return NULL and reach the n->value dereference.

control.parse_error: Model did not return a complete JSON review
control.assessment: Invents a requirement to move the removed guard into the scope of the calloc call; appended prose incorrectly treats calloc returning NULL on failure as unintended behavior. Reports physical line 12 instead of bracketed ID 1, and appends prose after JSON.

new.parse_error: Model finding lacks an exact changed-line citation
new.assessment: Invents a requirement to place the removed guard inside calloc itself instead of describing the newly unguarded NULL dereference. Reports physical line 12 instead of bracketed ID 1. The trailing prose is gone.

cases.name: short-read-accepted
cases.expected_mechanism: The new n == 0 check accepts fread results of 1, 2, or 3 and returns success for an incomplete four-byte tag.

control.assessment: Both reasons restate the removed and added checks. They do not explain the accepted partial reads or incorrect success return. Both IDs are available, but the returned set {1,2} differs from expected {2}.

new.assessment: Both reasons again restate the two changed checks, without explaining how one-to-three-byte reads now return success. Both IDs are available; the returned set is still {1,2}.

cases.name: archive-subprocess-forbidden
cases.expected_mechanism: The added execFileSync call launches external tar, conflicting with the root and tools/archive rules that require archive creation to remain in process.

control.assessment: Only describes removal of return. It gives no subprocess-policy conflict or consequence and cites the removed return (ID 1) instead of the added subprocess (ID 2).

new.assessment: Identical to the prior response: only describes removal of return and never connects the added tar process to the applicable rule.

positive_prefix.comparison: The smaller-step checkpoint removes trailing prose from the two training cases, raising complete JSON syntax from 2/4 to 4/4. Production-usable responses remain 2/4; neither arm supplies a grounded causal explanation or a passing complete review in these four conditioned cases.

method.cohort: Forty training prompts continued after the shared three-token prefix {"findings.
method.genuine_issue_detected: At least one finding explains the actual expected conflict or failure mechanism and cites an available causally appropriate changed line. Extra findings are assessed separately.
method.all_findings_grounded: Every reported finding has a supported causal explanation and an available causally appropriate changed-line citation; empty lists satisfy this condition.
method.full_review_pass: Production-usable review with all findings grounded and the expected issue detected, or an empty findings list for a clean case.
method.clean_counts: Production false positives, complete-JSON nonempty responses, and invalid clean responses are counted separately.
method.provenance: Each complete response was manually read against its exact diff and rules. Judgments are bound to response and prompt hashes; production parsing is recomputed. Exact prompts, chunks, decoding, model identity, and the native supplied-prefix boundary were checked against the training corpus and verification receipt.
method.malformed_responses: Visible finding reasons in malformed or prose-suffixed responses were also read, without repairing the response for production parsing. No such response identified a genuine causal concern. visible_line_ids records explicit line_id fields even when the full response is invalid.
method.grading: A rule quotation, diff restatement, or unsupported assertion of conflict does not itself explain a concrete causal concern. Alternative causally appropriate changed-line citations are accepted.
